hooks.name: Remind the agent to amend the spec before changing behavior
hooks.description: Keeps the spec-first habit that this project's write-up depends on.

action.prompt: Project rule: when real data or a test contradicts a requirement, amend the requirement in .kiro/specs/<spec>/requirements.md first, then change the code, then record the dated change in KIRO_USAGE.md. Do not patch behavior without recording why.
